adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 1’s overview jointly shows the protein input object as an amino-acid sequence in the Proteins modality panel and the linked protein foundation model context via the “Proteins: ESM3” backbone entry, making the protein-to-ESM3 input mechanism visible at overview level.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is too narrow because it isolates only the Proteins task panel and drops the adjacent backbone context. A better crop exists in the same figure: include the full left-to-center overview through the Biological Modalities section so the reader can see both the protein sequence representation and the paper’s protein foundation model reference (ESM3). Under the atlas rules, a shared architecture/overview figure can support a route when it visibly depicts the route-specific input object or representation, and a model box is not mandatory. This is defensible for the ESM-3 protein embedding route at a high level, but not for the protein metadata prompt, because the figure does not show the structured text prompt blocks or prompt-token interface.
